name: Spaceship 3aaf02c0 on 3.12.12
description: A period-6 spaceship on the truncated hexagonal tiling 3.12.12 (touching neighbours), 5 to 8 cells, moving (−2, 4) lattice steps every 6 generations. It runs the same way in the 32,768 rules from B2/S2 to B2,5,6,8,9,10,11,12/S2,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 1,585 times). Flagged as most likely already known: small (5 to 8 cells), common (seen 1,585 times) and wide-range (32,768 rules) on an Archimedean tiling. We found no earlier report, but others may well have seen it, so it is not claimed.
